notes.title: Monsters! is Now FREE!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the 10th Anniversary of the release of Monsters! it is now FREE on Steam!

[b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who bought the game over the years. You helped make our adventure into Indie Game development a reality.

Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Update for Anniversary Edition
notes.notes:
We've updated Monster! on Steam to the new 10th Anniversary Edition to celebrate the 10th Anniversary of the game's original release. We thought it would be fun to not only update the engine but also add a bit more polish to the game. The new edition plays similarly from the original version of the game but with some new challenges and surprises.

Here's a list of the changes in this new version:

    [list]
[*] NEW Level Difficulty Curve - There are now 35 unique levels of Monsters! to fight through.
[*]     NEW Monster Behaviors - A complete rework of Monster behaviors and some new ones added into the mix.
[*]     NEW "Remastered" Sprites - Monsters now come in a variety of vibrant pixelated colors!
[*]     NEW Particle Effects - More Juice!
[*]     NEW HUD Animations - Dragons go ROAR!
[*]     Updated Unity Engine - Support for 64bit Systems and Apple Silicon.
[/list]

Still in the works but coming soon:

    [list]
[*] New Chip Tune Soundtrack
[*]     New Promo Art for Stores
[/list]

notes.title: We Want Your Feedback on a New Version of Monsters!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/113a4358646f958b01d31a78640a395dfcea912b.png[/img]

We've been working on some improvements to the game lately. Everyone who has purchased the game will have access to the beta versions going forward. While we've been making some changes to the pixel art and the user interface, [b]our main goal with this beta version is to get some gameplay feedback.[/b] 

[i]We could use your help![/i] There have been some significant changes to gameplay with this version. Most notably with the enemy AI and overall flow of the levels. Getting your feedback during the design process would be an immense help. If you do want to help us out, you will have to set up Steam to download the beta for you (see the screenshots). 

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/492b29291dc610e1be6341c864ade56494b633e4.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/db0404460e615f123ce56e0b453a96589ed86bc8.png[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/62faef2936240842ebfb8bb04ba0da8c5d2f2df0.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9998687/65686584a1d427051d2f5af4ba2bc0527ad3f0aa.png[/img][/url]

I've created a discussion on the steam forums where players can post their feedback [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/336160/discussions/3/2906376154314099420/]here[/url].

All feedback is helpful so don't hold back. That said, we want to try and keep the feedback focused on if the new level progression, AI behaviors, and other game play feels fun.

I also want to note that we will be keeping the older version available through steam even when we release this newer version. That way folks who really enjoy the older version of the game can keep on enjoying it.

That's it for now.

Cheers!

notes.title: Monsters! Now on Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:
We are happy to have [b]Monsters![/b] out on [b]Steam Early Access[/b]! We've been waiting a long time for this to happen so our thanks go out to all of our fans who helped vote for the game on Steam Greenlight. Thanks also go out to all the folks who supported the game through [url=steamcommunity.com/app/336160/discussions/0/527273983050720952/#p1]bundle sales and Kickstarter[/url].

To up our game a bit, we want to add in [i]Steam Achievements[/i] and [i]Steam Leaderboards[/i]. We'll also be [i]tweaking gameplay[/i] and spicing up the user experience with a better [i]user interface[/i], [i]menus[/i], and [i]controller support[/i]. 

We are looking forward to getting the game into your hands and hearing your feedback on our improvements. See you all on the leaderboards!
